scope: Replayed only the exported closed timestamped receipts selected for known SQL contexts in the four measured windows and their batch parents/siblings. Original mixed backend stdout and invocations absent from that SQL-selected export are not reconstructed.
limits: Selected receipt availability is not full HTTP/RPC log coverage.

nativeLogin desktop.session has one aggregate physical/logical invocation but no selected receipt. The exported selection does not assign any known window SQL context to it; unknown-context SQL cannot be attributed or excluded.
Query diagnostic rows contain ordinal/context/statement/scope, not per-query wall-clock instants; this replay checks identity/parent/time closure, not timestamp attribution of each SQL start.
Existing unknown context and unknown statement rows remain included in every SQL budget total.
